title: MVP: A Motion-Predictive Speculative Vision Pipeline with Non-Blocking Drift Correction
summary: Continuous Vision (CV) systems underpin real-time applications such as autonomous driving and augmented reality, where latency, throughput, and energy are tightly constrained on mobile platforms. Modern CV SoC pipelines, however, still serialize image capture and processing, leading to high end-to-end latency.
